stalls.summaryZh: 被封為朴子第一名，炸得金黃酥脆，冷了仍脆，價格便宜。
stalls.summaryEn: Widely called Puzi's top pick: golden and crisp, still crunchy when cold, and cheap.

stalls.summaryZh: 排隊可長達半小時，外酥內鬆配清爽泡菜，炸粿也不油。
stalls.summaryEn: Queues can hit 30 minutes; crisp-fluffy tofu with refreshing pickles, and the fried rice cake isn't greasy.

stalls.summaryZh: 整尾大魷魚現炸，朴子夜市代表攤之一。
stalls.summaryEn: Whole large squid fried to order, one of the market's signature stalls.

sources.title: 食尚玩家：嘉義夜市懶人包

stalls.summaryZh: 一人掌鍋手腳快但仍要排隊，蛋不乾不柴、調味可選。
stalls.summaryEn: One fast-working cook but still a queue; eggs stay tender, with several seasonings to choose.

stalls.summaryZh: 牌樓下人潮最多的烤肉攤。
